#[path = "shared_slice.rs"]
mod shared_slice;
struct Wrong(std::ops::Range<u32>);
impl Iterator for Wrong {
    type Item = u32;
    fn next(&mut self) -> Option<u32> {
        self.0.next()
    }
    fn size_hint(&self) -> (usize, Option<usize>) {
        (CLAIMED, Some(CLAIMED))
    }
}
impl ExactSizeIterator for Wrong {}
fn main() {
    let mut pool = shared_slice::SharedSlicePool::default();
    let _ = pool.alloc(Wrong(0..ACTUAL));
    panic!("incorrect length was accepted");
}
